purpose: Establish current-f01e AutoRound TP4/MTP1/eager/F16 exact-8K evidence against the frozen same-topology TP4/MTP0 oracle. Require exact depth, isolated positive/conserved acceptance, exact 128-token target parity, objective cache-zero quality, four-rank identity, cache isolation, and cleanup. TP1 comparisons are context only.

parent_oracle.gate: Candidate must exactly equal all 128 token IDs from this same-image, same-topology MTP0 receipt.

context_only.tp1_mtp0_exact_8k: The TP4/MTP0 parent also matched the current-f01e TP1/MTP0 token hash 34e792cc..., but TP1 is never the MTP1 target or quality baseline.

speculator_binding.type: native embedded Qwen MTP; no external draft model

acceptance_contract.snapshot_scope: Prometheus snapshots immediately before and after only the exact 8K request; startup and quality traffic excluded
acceptance_contract.gate: drafted delta > 0, accepted delta > 0, and accepted <= drafted

quality_contract.objective_gate: pass_all plus exactly 16 usage records (7 exact, 8 repeat, 1 long context), each explicitly reporting prompt_tokens_details.cached_tokens == 0; missing cache telemetry fails
quality_contract.comparison_grade: same-topology TP4/MTP0 baseline_match_all is recorded separately and may produce a lower-grade passed sentinel caveat

cache_contract.policy: Fresh vLLM rank_<rank>_0 namespaces; graph-off expects no compile artifacts, otherwise all four namespaces and no shared compile files are mandatory.

terminal_classification.passed-quality-clean-tp4-mtp1-sentinel: All TP4 identity, topology, exact-depth, isolated acceptance, same-topology parity, objective quality, same-topology MTP0 baseline comparison, cache, and cleanup gates pass.
terminal_classification.passed-quality-clean-tp4-mtp1-with-basel: All mandatory TP4/MTP1 gates pass but the same-topology MTP0 baseline comparison differs; retain usable lower-grade TP4/MTP1 evidence with the caveat.
terminal_classification.quarantined-acceptance-failed: Exact request passes but isolated counters do not prove positive conserved speculative activity.
terminal_classification.quarantined-target-verification-failed: Exact request passes but differs from the frozen same-topology TP4/MTP0 oracle.
terminal_classification.quarantined-objective-quality-failed: Exact request passes but objective quality or explicit cache-zero usage fails.
terminal_classification.unsupported: Only an exact-image explicit native MTP/speculative unsupported log classification.
terminal_classification.failed: Infrastructure, binding, startup, identity, topology, metrics, cache, or cleanup failure; preserve raw evidence.
